decisions.reason: Product A builds directly on the firm's existing passenger data and government compliance knowledge, and its quantified adoption by the UK Home Office and over 30 APIS schemes signals clear value the firm can assimilate and improve.

Product B extends established travel and risk information capabilities into health requirements, an adjacent area where the firm can interpret early uptake and apply its integration know-how, so it is likely to keep.

Product F combines document verification and web platform expertise already present in the firm, and continued website presence suggests ongoing customer engagement that the firm can absorb and refine.
